signature.instructions:
**Task Overview**
You are to generate a complete, Blueprint‑compliant citation package for a single digital object (the *primary* object).  A secondary object may be described only for contrast – do **not** combine it with the primary citation.

**Reference Document**
All citation elements, metadata fields, and recommended formats must follow the official NIAID Blueprint (version v2 dated 26 Sep 2025) located at  

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-fair-us/ai-blueprint-core/refs/heads/master/docs/BluePrint/NIAID_Blueprint_v2_26Sep2025_forExternal.md`

If you cannot retrieve this file, state that explicitly before proceeding and then base your answer on the Blueprint sections cited in the “Grounding Summary” (see below).

**Input You Will Receive**
A markdown block containing the following fields (any may be missing; treat missing values as “not provided”):

* **Title** – study or dataset title  
* **Repository** – name and URL of the hosting repository  
* **Landing page** – URL of the study’s public page  
* **Persistent identifier (DOI)** – full DOI URL (e.g., `https://doi.org/10.21430/M3KXJHSP4T`)  
* **Accession** – repository‑specific accession number (e.g., `SDY998`)  
* **Description** – short free‑text description of the object  
* **Creators** – list of ORCID IDs (comma‑separated) – the Blueprint treats these as the *author* block; if you have no name information, use “Study Investigators” as a placeholder and include the ORCID IDs.  
* **Funders** – list of funder ROR IDs plus any grant numbers (e.g., `NIAID (https://ror.org/043z4tv69); grant 1UH2AR067676-01`)  
* **License / Use** – URL of the license or user‑agreement page; also provide the *license name* (e.g., “ImmPort User Agreement”) if known.  
* **Related publication** – citation of a journal article that describes the study (optional, for explanatory text only).  
* **Optional secondary object** – a separate dataset that must be described *only* as a contrasting example; do **not** merge its metadata with the primary citation.

**Output Requirements**
Your response must contain **four distinct sections**, each clearly labelled.

1. **Grounding Summary** – state whether you accessed the Blueprint document. If you did, quote the exact Section numbers (e.g., “Section 1.2 Minimal Metadata Schema”, “Section 3.1 Minimal API Specification”) that you are using. If you could not retrieve it, note this and explain that you are using the last‑known Blueprint guidance.

2. **Human‑Readable Citation** – a single citation string formatted exactly as the Blueprint prescribes for ImmPort‑type datasets:
   - `Creator(s). (Year). *Title* (Version X.Y) [Data set]. Repository Name. DOI`
   - Include the **year** from the DOI’s metadata if you can infer it; otherwise use “n.d.”.
   - Append the accession in parentheses after the title *only if* the Blueprint’s “Citation Elements” list it as a required component.
   - Example for the primary object:
     > Smith J, Doe A, Brown C, Lee D. (2024). *SDY998: AMP Rheumatoid Arthritis Phase 1* (Version 1.0) [Data set]. ImmPort Shared Data. https://doi.org/10.21430/M3KXJHSP4T

3. **Machine‑Actionable Citation (JSON‑LD)** – a JSON‑LD block that:
   - Uses `@context: "https://schema.org/"` and `@type: "Dataset"`.
   - Contains **all required Blueprint metadata** (Section 1.2) and any **recommended** fields you have values for:
     - `name` (title)
     - `description`
     - `identifier` (array of `PropertyValue` items for DOI and Accession)
     - `url` (landing‑page URL)
     - `author` (array of objects; each with `@type: "Person"`, `name` (if known or placeholder “Study Investigator”), `@id` = `https://orcid.org/XXXX‑XXXX‑XXXX‑XXXX`)
     - `publisher` (object with `@type: "Organization"` and `name`, `url`)
     - `datePublished` (year or `null`)
     - `version` (if a version is supplied)
     - `license` (object with `@type: "CreativeWork"` and both `name` and `url`)
     - `funding` (array of objects: each with `@type: "Grant"`; include `funder` with ROR ID URI, and `grantId` when supplied)
     - `citation` (the DOI URL as a plain string, to help downstream tools)
     - `keywords` (optional: pull key terms from the description if any)
   - Ends with a *trailing comment* (plain text, not JSON) that explains why this structure satisfies the Blueprint (e.g., “Provides persistent identifiers, author ORCIDs, and a machine‑readable license”).

   Example skeleton (fill with real values):
   ```json
   {
     "@context": "https://schema.org/",
     "@type": "Dataset",
     "name": "SDY998: AMP Rheumatoid Arthritis Phase 1",
     "description": "Open‑access ImmPort study … (full description from input)",
     "identifier": [
       {
         "@type": "PropertyValue",
         "propertyID": "DOI",
         "value": "10.21430/M3KXJHSP4T",
         "url": "https://doi.org/10.21430/M3KXJHSP4T"
       },
       {
         "@type": "PropertyValue",
         "propertyID": "Accession",
         "value": "SDY998",
         "url": "https://www.immport.org/shared/study/SDY998"
       }
     ],
     "url": "https://www.immport.org/shared/study/SDY998",
     "author": [
       {
         "@type": "Person",
         "name": "Study Investigator",
         "@id": "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1450-1549"
       },
       {
         "@type": "Person",
         "name": "Study Investigator",
         "@id": "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1219-3845"
       },
       {
         "@type": "Person",
         "name": "Study Investigator",
         "@id": "https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4483-0359"
       },
       {
         "@type": "Person",
         "name": "Study Investigator",
         "@id": "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5634-7746"
       }
     ],
     "publisher": {
       "@type": "Organization",
       "name": "ImmPort Shared Data",
       "url": "https://www.immport.org/"
     },
     "datePublished": "2024",
     "version": "1.0",
     "license": {
       "@type": "CreativeWork",
       "name": "ImmPort User Agreement",
       "url": "https://www.immport.org/agreement"
     },
     "funding": [
       {
         "@type": "Grant",
         "funder": {
           "@type": "Organization",
           "name": "NIAID",
           "url": "https://ror.org/043z4tv69"
         },
         "grantId": "1UH2AR067676-01"
       },
       {
         "@type": "Grant",
         "funder": {
           "@type": "Organization",
           "name": "NIAMS",
           "url": "https://ror.org/006zn3t30"
         }
       }
     ],
     "citation": "https://doi.org/10.21430/M3KXJHSP4T",
     "keywords": ["rheumatoid arthritis","flow cytometry","CyTOF","RNA‑seq","microscopy"]
   }
   // This JSON‑LD follows Blueprint Section 1.2 (required fields) and Section 3.1 (machine‑readable citation) by providing persistent identifiers, author ORCIDs, a clear license, and funding information, enabling automated discovery, credit‑allocation, and compliance checks.
   ```

4. **Implementation & Outreach Guidance** – three brief bullet‑point groups:
   - **API Specification** – give a minimal REST endpoint that any ImmPort‑like repository could expose, e.g.:

     *Endpoint*: `GET /datasets/{doi}`  
     *Response*: `application/ld+json` containing the JSON‑LD block above.  
     *Example*: `GET https://api.immport.org/datasets/10.21430/M3KXJHSP4T` → returns the JSON‑LD.

   - **Repository‑Side Checklist** – steps the data‑steward should take to make the citation available (populate fields, validate against the Blueprint JSON‑LD schema, add a `<cite>` element with the human‑readable string on the landing page, register the endpoint in the repository’s OpenAPI spec).

   - **User‑Facing Training** – a short outreach plan (one‑page “Citation Best Practices” PDF, a 5‑minute tutorial video, and a webinar for investigators) that explicitly shows how to copy the human‑readable citation, retrieve the JSON‑LD via the API, and cite the dataset in manuscripts.

   End this section with a one‑sentence statement of **why** the Blueprint prefers this combined human/machine format (e.g., “It simultaneously satisfies scholarly credit, funder compliance, and FAIR machine‑actionability”).

**General Styling Rules**
- Use **GitHub‑flavored markdown** for headings (`###`) and code fences.
- Do **not** embed any explanatory prose inside the JSON‑LD code fence; place explanations only in comments outside the JSON block (as shown).
- Keep the human‑readable citation on a single line, prefixed by `>` (blockquote) for readability.
- All URLs must be absolute and HTTPS.
- Do **not** expose any private or controlled‑access details from the secondary object; simply note it as a *contrast example* in a separate, optional paragraph under the Implementation Guidance (e.g., “For contrast, a controlled‑access COVID‑19 trial is cited differently…”).

**Evaluation Checklist (for you)**
- [ ] Blueprint document accessed (or explicit statement of inability).  
- [ ] All required Blueprint metadata present in JSON‑LD.  
- [ ] ORCID IDs are represented as `@id` URIs.  
- [ ] License includes both name and URL.  
- [ ] Funding includes ROR URIs and grant IDs.  
- [ ] Accession appears as a `PropertyValue` with `propertyID: "Accession"`.  
- [ ] `citation` property included.  
- [ ] Minimal API endpoint description supplied.  
- [ ] Outreach/training bullet points included.  
- [ ] No mixing of secondary object into primary citation.  

Follow these instructions exactly to produce a Blueprint‑compliant citation package for the digital object described in the user’s prompt.

The full response the prompt asks for: free text and/or structured JSON as specified by the instructions.
